verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for a payments platform, but the evidence pack never documents bulk data export, open-format downloads (e.g. CSV/JSON), or an offboarding or migration-out path. API access and Dashboard management are only building blocks, and the pricing note about recovering from a previous processor concerns migrating in, not leaving.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
